_comment: DESIGN-ONLY routine example. Tool names are cross-validated against the canonical toolbox namespace, but no routine runtime, APIM dispatch, or inherited governance path exists. Run scripts/provision-foundry-routine.py to validate and print the proposal. There is no --create because azure-ai-projects 2.4.0 exposes an incompatible trigger-to-agent routine model.
name: research-brief
description: Proposed two-step research brief: gather grounded sources, then synthesize a cited summary. Future implementation must prove how named tools are routed and governed.

steps.name: gather
steps.instructions: Use web-search to collect authoritative sources for the user's question. Prefer primary and recent sources; record every URL.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.instructions: Write a concise brief that answers the question. Cite every claim from the gathered sources using the citation format required by the consuming application.
